title: 구청에 전화해서 고장 신고하기: 언제 고쳐 주세요?
objective: Report a local problem by phone and use -던데 to ask for action.
summary: Listen to a resident report a broken streetlight, and learn -던데.
setting: A resident calls the district office (구청) complaints desk to report a streetlight that has gone out in the alley near their home.

task.title: Practice the report call
task.line: Use the words and the -던데 pattern from the dialogue to complete each item.

words.meaning: to officially take in (a report or application)
words.exampleMeaning: If you give me the documents, I'll register them right away.

words.example: 가로등이 없어서 밤에 길이 너무 어두워요.
words.exampleMeaning: There are no streetlights, so the road is very dark at night.

words.example: 화장실 불이 계속 깜빡거려서 눈이 아파요.
words.exampleMeaning: The bathroom light keeps flickering, and it hurts my eyes.

words.example: 사고가 난 위치를 정확히 알려 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Please tell us exactly where the accident happened.

words.example: 이 일은 담당 부서로 전화를 돌려 드릴게요.
words.exampleMeaning: For this matter, I'll transfer your call to the department in charge.

words.meaning: to handle, to take care of (a request)
words.example: 요청하신 일은 이번 주 안에 처리하겠습니다.
words.exampleMeaning: We will take care of your request within this week.
If you leave your contact number, we'll call you back.

dialogue.korean: 안녕하세요. 집 앞 골목에 있는 가로등이 며칠째 꺼져 있어서 전화드렸어요.
dialogue.meaning: Hello. I'm calling because the streetlight in the alley in front of my house has been out for several days.

dialogue.korean: 불편을 드려서 죄송합니다. 정확한 위치를 말씀해 주시겠어요?
dialogue.meaning: I'm sorry for the trouble. Could you tell me the exact location?

dialogue.korean: 한빛시장 뒤쪽 골목이에요. 어젯밤에 보니까 옆 가로등도 깜빡거리던데 같이 확인해 주실 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: It's the alley behind Hanbit Market. Last night I saw the light next to it flickering too. Could you check that one as well?

dialogue.korean: 접수됐습니다. 담당 부서에서 확인한 후에 처리 결과를 문자로 알려 드릴 거예요.
dialogue.meaning: It's registered. After the department in charge checks it, you'll get the result by text message.

exercises: Combine the two sentences with -던데: 아까 보니까 길에 물이 새고 있었어요. / 수도관이 터진 것 같아요.
Fill in the blank with the -던데 form of 필요하다: 지난달에 신청할 때는 서류가 하나만 ____ 이번에는 왜 두 개예요?
Choose the right word for each blank (위치, 담당 부서, 연락처, 처리): ① 이 문제는 제가 ____에 전달해 드릴게요. ② 휴대폰 번호 같은 ____를 남겨 주세요. ③ 쓰레기가 쌓여 있는 정확한 ____가 어디예요?
Answer in Korean with -던데: You noticed yesterday that the trash in front of your building was still there. Tell the staff and ask when they can clear it away.
answers: 아까 보니까 길에 물이 새고 있던데 수도관이 터진 것 같아요.
① 담당 부서 ② 연락처 ③ 위치
어제 보니까 건물 앞에 쓰레기가 그대로 있던데 언제 치워 주실 수 있어요?
